name: PinMaze RN Caduceus Emblem Lapel Pin
seoTitle: RN Caduceus Lapel Pin for Pinning Ceremony
metaDescription: A registered nurse lapel pin with RN letters on a caduceus emblem. A classic, budget friendly gift for a pinning ceremony, graduation, or new license.
summary: An RN caduceus lapel pin that marks the moment a nursing student becomes a registered nurse. A classic keepsake for pinning day.
whyItWorks: Pinning ceremonies are one of nursing's oldest traditions, the moment a graduate is welcomed into the profession. Many schools present their own official pin, so a separate RN emblem pin gives family and friends a way to join in. It can be worn on a lab coat, a blazer at a job interview, or a scrub jacket, and it marks the license she studied so hard for without being loud about it.

Gifts tied to a milestone often become keepsakes, and a pin is easy to tuck in a jewelry box and bring out for Nurses Week or a hospital award dinner. The RN letters on the caduceus are simple and recognizable. It also works for passing the NCLEX, when a new grad finally gets to sign RN after her name. Give it with a card that notes the date and you have a small heirloom.
goodToKnow: If her school gives an official pin at the ceremony, present this as a second keepsake rather than a replacement.
Check the listing photos for the finish and clasp style.
It is designed for RNs, so choose a different pin for LPN or NP graduates.

faq.q: Is this a good pinning ceremony gift?
faq.a: Yes, an RN lapel pin fits the spirit of the ceremony well. Since many schools provide their own pin, this one works best as an extra keepsake from family or friends.

faq.q: Can she wear it at work?
faq.a: It suits a lab coat, scrub jacket, or blazer. Some units limit jewelry and pins on clinical clothing, so it may be best for ceremonies and events.
